content.Clinical Guidelines: 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Valvular Heart Disease
content.Section: 3.4.2.4. Choice of SAVR Versus TAVI for Patients for Whom a Bioprosthesis Valve Is Appropriate
Key Points: Transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) vs. surgical aortic valve replacement (SAVR) options are considered.
Comparison between procedural outcomes, survival, and complications post valve replacement.
Various studies discuss long-term outcomes and various patient demographics such as age groups, risk profiles, and type of valve used.
